name: SYS-DAT S.p.A.
summary: SYS-DAT S.p.A. is an information and communication technology (ICT) company with operations spanning Italy and international markets. The firm offers an extensive array of IT solutions, encompassing business intelligence, cloud computing, customer relationship management, comprehensive digital suites for retail and sales, energy optimization, e-commerce platforms, electronic data interchange, and enterprise resource planning. Furthermore, their expertise extends to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and privacy compliance, document management, and networking infrastructure. The company also provides advanced solutions in human resources management, artificial intelligence, digital product passports, product data management, radio frequency identification, robust information security, manufacturing execution systems (MES) and manufacturing operations management (MOM), as well as supply chain and warehouse management systems. Serving a vast and varied client base, SYS-DAT caters to sectors such as banking, ceramics, publishing, fashion and luxury, food and beverage, legal, logistics, manufacturing, retail and distribution, healthcare, smart and digital offices, agribusiness, general services, and textiles. Established in 1977, the company was initially incorporated as Sys-Dat Elaboratori S.r.l., before officially changing its name to SYS-DAT S.p.A. in July 2011. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Milan, Italy.
